## ⚠️ 提交提示 / Submission Notice

欢迎关注本项目！

- **中文**：本项目所有开源项目收录与更新统一通过 **[Issue 专用通道](https://github.com/logicrw/awesome-jev-projects/issues/new?template=project.yml)** 进行。本仓库**不接收任何形式的 Pull Request**（包括但不限于项目收录、网站 UI 改造、脚本调整或测试增补，所有提交的 PR 均会自动关闭）。请直接前往 [新建 Issue 提交项目](https://github.com/logicrw/awesome-jev-projects/issues/new?template=project.yml) 填写即可，感谢配合！
- **English**: All project submissions and updates for this directory are handled **exclusively via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/logicrw/awesome-jev-projects/issues/new?template=project.yml)**. This repository **does not accept Pull Requests of any kind** (including site features, UI changes, scripts, or testing, and all opened PRs will be closed automatically). Please close this PR and submit your project through the [New Issue submission template](https://github.com/logicrw/awesome-jev-projects/issues/new?template=project.yml). Thank you for your understanding!
